services.desc: Adult (Ages 12+): $50 Child (Ages 2-11): $50 Infant (Under 2 years old): Free but still requires a ticket | Must be accompanied by Adult 1.5 Hours About This tour will haul and set lobster traps in Casco Bay, alongside beautiful landmarks and sea life. This fun and interacting environment offers an experience to feel like a Maine lobsterman and grasp the concept of the lobster 1.5 Hours · All Ages · Feel like a Maine Lobsterman!

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Adult (Ages 12+): $55 1.5 Hours About Maine sunsets are one for the eyes! Enjoy this lobster boat cruise around the islands of Casco Bay while watching the sun set over the Portland skyline. This cruise has the option to add a lobster roll from Luke's Lobster, you can do so during booking. BYOB and BYO snacks are 1.5 Hours · 21+ · Catch Maine's Spectacular Sunset!
